headline: TUPAC 🩸 VERDICT Could SPARK 💥 Biggie 🔫 Killer Hunt?
text:
The CONVICTION 🧑‍⚖️ of Duane "Keffe D" 🍩 Davis in LAS VEGAS 🏜️ has finally BUSTED 💥 open one of the MOST 📢 famous UNSOLVED 🔍 murder cases ever after SPRAYING 🚗 bullets into that black BMW 🖤 in the 1996 drive-by that took out TUPAC SHAKUR 🎤 the GREATEST RAPPER 🏆 of all time!! Former PROSECUTOR 🧑‍💼 Neama Rahmani told the BBC 📻 this is HUGE 🏋️ it was a tough COLD CASE ❄️ with ZERO arrests for THIRTY YEARS 🕰️ and now it might INSPIRE new EFFORTS 🕵️ to hunt the killer of his RAP RIVAL 😤 Notorious B.I.G. who got hit in an almost IDENTICAL drive-by months later!! "This gives CLOSURE 🔒 to Shakur's FAMILY 👨‍👩‍👧," observers are saying while asking if the same 🔥 heat could now RAIL 💦 the unsolved Biggie file too bro!!

Duane Davis straight up KNEW 🧠 Wallace and was at the EXACT SAME PARTY 🎉 the night Biggie got MURDERED 🔪 in Los Angeles after the two EAST COAST 🌆 WEST COAST 🌴 titans went from FRIENDS 👥 to bitter RIVALS 🥊 embodying that 90s hip-hop FEUD 🔥 which left both of them SHOT 🩸 in similar drive-by CIRCUMSTANCES 🚙 with no charges ever filed!! Journalist Justin Tinsley author of that Biggie book 📖 told the BBC these two men were so UNIQUE 🎨 TALENTED 🏅 and IMPACTFUL 🧨 separately yet it's IMPOSSIBLE to tell one STORY 📖 without the other because they're FOREVER CONNECTED 🔗 by mutual figures and ANCILLARY players who keep popping up like that investigator who TESTIFIED 🗣️ at the Tupac trial after interviewing Davis!! People been saying for DECADES the murders are LINKED ⛓️ and now with Keffe D COOKED 🧑‍🍳 maybe LAPD will get off their ass and take another look at this STAIN 🩸 on their record!!

The BREAKTHROUGH 💡 in solving the Shakur case came down to Davis running his MOUTH 🗣️ nonstop through DOCUMENTARIES 🎥 his own MEMOIR 📕 podcasts and even a SECRET POLICE INTERVIEW 🕵️ where he basically ADMITTED tossing the firearm 🔫 in the backseat so his nephew Orlando Anderson could fatally SHOOT Tupac as they PULLED UP 🚗 alongside that vehicle in Vegas on September 7 1996!! Anderson himself got SHOT DEAD 💀 in 1998 after denying everything but during the TRIAL there were ZERO eye-witnesses no MURDER WEAPON 🛠️ no video evidence and the DEFENSE went hard arguing there wasn't even PROOF Davis was in Las Vegas that night making it an UPHILL CLIMB 🧗‍♂️ for prosecutors who still went for it like absolute CHADS 💪!! Rahmani called it a gutsy move because when you're a prosecutor you're expected to WIN 🏆 every time yet they got JUSTICE ⚖️ where others didn't even bother trying while Davis's attorney begged the jury to see his client as just a LIAR 🐍 selling books for CASH 💰 with zero actual facts!!

When that GUILTY VERDICT 🧾 got read in court the Shakur FAMILY 👪 had a massive outpouring of EMOTION 😢 some cried into tissues others HUGGED 🤗 and held hands while one member even EMBRACED a prosecutor in pure RELIEF 🥹!! At the press conference Clark County District Attorney Steve Wolfson thanked the judge the team and Tupac's people saying they waited THIRTY YEARS 🕰️ for this and are finally RELIEVED to have JUSTICE after their loved one was MURDERED in cold blood!! Trial lawyer Shaun Kent explained the case EVOLVED 📈 with every single interview Davis gave because there were no other witnesses besides HIMSELF 🪞 making him the STRONGEST witness against himself and Rahmani believes Davis would have NEVER been charged if he just shut up instead of giving interviews even from CUSTODY ⛓️ like he couldn't stop himself!!

The whole Shakur trial forced the jury to time travel back to the 1990s era of intense GANG VIOLENCE 🧨 that seeped into hip-hop with those EAST COAST WEST COAST rivalries plus deep mistrust in POLICING 👮 and a street code that said never snitch to authorities!! Even Tupac after getting HIT multiple times in the drive-by refused to talk and told cops in the ambulance "We'll take care of it" 🚑 which got ECHOED months later when Biggie one of the biggest East Coast rappers left an after-party for the Soul Train Music Awards and got BLASTED by a black Chevrolet at a red light on March 9 1997 almost exactly six months after Shakur!! Both were GRAMMY-NOMINATED 🏆 artists at the top making MILLIONS 💰 with constant radio play while their BEEF spilled into lyrics threats and actual street VIOLENCE that erupted in Los Angeles as gangs tried to settle scores!!

For YEARS neither case led to any arrests just endless RUMORS and CONSPIRACIES but now with Tupac's conviction Rahmani thinks it might EMBOLDEN Los Angeles prosecutors to dust off this COLD CASE that's nearing 30 years because it's a total STAIN on the LAPD that this could happen on a public street in the second biggest US city with zero movement!! The LAPD told the BBC they are AWARE of the conviction and the investigation into Christopher Wallace remains ACTIVE and OPEN urging anyone with tips to come forward while Tinsley noted people will search for CLOSURE any way they can after trying to make sense of it for three decades!! Even though both legends have been gone longer than they were ALIVE their mythology and those deaths will always stay a HOT TOPIC of conversation so maybe this verdict is the SPARK that finally gets Biggie's killer too!!
